welcome.title: Welcome to the Landing Page Builder! 👋
welcome.description: Let's take a quick tour so you know exactly where everything is before you start building.

insertPanel.title: Add content here
insertPanel.description: This is the Insert panel — everything you add to your page starts here. Let's look at the three main things you can insert.

addSection.title: Sections stack your page
addSection.description: A Section is a full-width row on your page. Click "Section" to add one — pages are usually just a few sections stacked top to bottom (hero, features, footer, etc.).

addBlock.title: Blocks organize a section
addBlock.description: A Block lives inside a section and groups content together, like a card or a column. Click "Block" to add one wherever you've selected.

addContents.title: Contents are what visitors see
addContents.description: Text, Image, and Button are the actual content that goes inside a block — this is what your visitors read, look at, and click.

canvas.title: This is your canvas
canvas.description: This is your live page. Click any element to select it, then edit its content and style using the panel on the right.

propertyPanel.title: Switch to the Property panel
propertyPanel.description: Click this icon to switch from the Insert panel to the Property panel — this is where you'll style and configure whatever you select.

propertyControls.title: Adjust what you select
propertyControls.description: Once something is selected, its colors, spacing, text, borders, and other settings show up here — this is where you fine-tune the look of anything on your page.

pageName.title: Name your page
pageName.description: Click the page title in the top bar to rename it — this is how you'll find it later in your dashboard.

viewSwitcher.title: Preview at different sizes
viewSwitcher.description: Switch between Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile here to see how your page adapts to each screen size.

thumbnailCapture.title: Capture a thumbnail
thumbnailCapture.description: Open the Page Settings panel to capture and update the thumbnail image shown for this page in your dashboard.

changeImage.title: Open the thumbnail creator
changeImage.description: Click "Change" to open the thumbnail creation dialog for this page.

createThumbnail.title: Choose a count and create it
createThumbnail.description: Inside the dialog, choose how many sections to include in the preview, then click Create to capture and save a new thumbnail for your page.

save.title: Save your work
save.description: Changes aren't published until you save. Click here (or press Ctrl+S) any time to save your progress.

preview.title: Preview your page
preview.description: See exactly how your page will look to visitors before you publish it.

done.title: You're all set! 🎉
done.description: That's the essentials. Explore freely — you can always reopen this guide from the help button in the top bar.
